response.original_title: The Vampire Lestat: One Night Only LIVE
response.overview: The Vampire Lestat: One Night Only was a live promotional event held on June 2, 2026 at the Beacon Theater in New York City. The event included a screening of the first episode of The Vampire Lestat, followed by an approximately thirty minute long performance of songs from the season by Sam Reid, in character as Lestat, and composer and songwriter Daniel Hart.
